title: Development of a prognostic model for sepsis based on gut microbiota-associated genes and identification of potential targets.

models.verbatim_formula: GMGscore = sum(Exp_i x Coef_i), Exp_i = standardized expression
models.reported_performance: AUC 0.903 training (GSE65682); AUC 0.901 validation (GSE95233); nomogram (age + GMGscore) AUC 0.907
models.source_location: Methods (GMGscore formula); Results Fig. 3; Supplementary Table S4 (sheet TableS4_LASSO, LASSO coefficients)

notes: Coefficients from Supplementary Table S4 (LASSO coefficients at lambda=0.01; no separate multivariate Cox refit reported). DEG dataset printed variously as GSE154918/GSE154928/GSE154981 in the text; Supplementary Table S1 confirms GSE154918. GSE95233 n=102 sepsis samples (includes repeated sampling per patient). AUC metric (ROC for 28-day mortality, not time-dependent) as reported.
